results.title: How to Measure the ROI of AI Code Assistants - Jellyfish
results.content: To measure the return on investment (ROI) of AI code assistants, we need to stop asking developers how they *feel* and start tracking what they *do*. This guide shows you how to measure AI’s actual impact, grounded in our own original research that analyzed the day-to-day impact of tools like GitHub Copilot across multiple, real-world development teams. AI helps developers break work into smaller pieces and ship them faster, so teams often see 20-30% more deployments unless they’re already shipping multiple times daily. Initially, this might go up while teams adapt to AI code quality, but it typically drops once developers know what to watch for. * Developers spend more time fixing AI code than writing their own. Jellyfish is a software engineering intelligence platform that centralizes data from your development tools and AI assistants to show how engineering work connects to business outcomes and team performance. * How to Use AI in Software Development: 7 Best Practices & Examples for Engineering Teams.
